text: The REST API answers (HTTP 200) when it is asked, also while the pipeline is under full load
goal: at least 99 percent of the calls

text: The REST API answers quickly, measured from your computer over the internet
goal: at most 1,000 milliseconds, for 95 percent of the answers

text: A new event can be read from the REST API soon after Kafka has stored it, with one producer and with the autoscaler at its maximum
measured: one producer: 0.1 s, autoscaler at its maximum: 16.0 s

text: With the load on, the producers' autoscaler has all its pods ready
goal: at most 180 seconds after the autoscaler was freed
measured: all producer pods were ready after 41 s

text: After the load stops, the producers are back to the minimum of 1 pod
goal: at most 180 seconds after the load was switched off
measured: the producers were back to the minimum after 36 s

text: After the load stops, the processors catch up: the backlog in Kafka is below 1,000 messages
goal: at most 300 seconds after the load was switched off
measured: the backlog was gone after 54 s

text: After the load stops, the processors are back to the minimum of 1 pod
goal: at most 600 seconds after the load was switched off
measured: the processors were back to the minimum after 175 s (2.9 min)
